issue: open issue e: export_field solid mask one node layer short on the -y and -z faces
body: cube -1 to 1 m on every axis, faces exactly on grid planes (index 30 and 70)
cause: column range rounding: dy = gy[1] - gy[0] = 0.04999999999999982, (-1 - y0) / dy = 30.0000000000001, ceil gives 31, so the y = -1 and z = -1 columns were never tested
diagonal tie: a column on the shared diagonal of the two triangles of an x face counts two crossings per face, so the pair test filled only the two end nodes
fix: inside_mask casts each column four times offset by (+-1e-3 dy, +-0.618e-3 dz) and ORs the results, x span widened by 1e-3 dx; nodes on the surface count as solid on every face
synthetic_test: tests/test_pure.py SolidMask: grid-aligned cube gives 41^3 = 68921 and mirror symmetry; cube at +-0.97 gives 39^3 = 59319 (no inflation)
U_p_at_added_nodes: 0 (write_field_npz zeroes every solid node; U = 0 is the no-slip wall value, p = 0 there is not physical and is clipped from the slice)
note: a fresh export rewrites the verdict block from the log history to 2000 (kept as forces_1831e_verdict2000.json); the gated record was restored as forces.json, as in Stage 1. Backups: field_1831_pre_e.npz, forces_1831_pre_e.json, export_field_pre_e.py
